title: Matsubara two-pole sum as occupancy Newton quotient (underspecified)
expression_sketch: (1/beta)*Sum(1/((I*omega_n - xi1)*(I*omega_n - xi2)), n) == -eta*(n_eta(xi1) - n_eta(xi2))/(xi1 - xi2)  with n_eta(xi)=1/(exp(beta*xi)-eta), eta=±1
latent_structure: Would be Newton first divided difference of the Fermi/Bose function n_eta, plus the repeated-node row (i omega - xi)^{-2} = -eta n_eta'(xi). Latent F = n_eta. Not CSE. Cannot be admitted: required pole exclusions are not declared in the table.

why_not_cse_lgg: The compact side is a first Newton DD of n_eta. That is beyond CSE. Admission is blocked by missing analytic-domain predicates, not by triviality of the algebra.
proposer_leak_risk: If ever re-posed, hide 'Newton divided difference', 'Hermite', and occupancy names. Do not repair the domain by importing pole-exclusion from another problem.
notes: Preserved rejected dossier. Footnote on the table: the simple-pole sum (iω-ξ)^{-1} 'does not converge' and 'may differ upon different choice of the Matsubara weighting function'. The two-pole row is the interesting latent DD but xi1≠xi2 and Matsubara-pole exclusion are NOT_DECLARED. Do not import Guo's missing pole-exclusion; do not insert beta>0 from folklore. Verdict: PROBLEM_UNDERSPECIFIED, not DISCOVERY_FAILURE.
reject_reason: PROBLEM_UNDERSPECIFIED: verifier-needed predicates xi1≠xi2 and exclusion of Matsubara poles of g are NOT_DECLARED in the cited table. Physical folklore T>0/beta>0 is not a license to complete the domain.
